reviews.title: “Partiful will not make money. There is no pitch at scale.”
Superior UI Ruined By Cell Phone Requirement and Aggressive App Download Request.
reviews.text: Not having an email confirmation option for my guests is deal breaker.  Also attempting to force the app download for a simple invite confirmation is a terrible customer experience.  You dont need my guests cell phone, plain and simple. Offer an email option or I’ll never be a customer.

reviews.title: One star for making me download the app just to view guest list
I don’t want to download your stupid app
reviews.text: Just keep letting me do everything from the website nobody cares about you or partiful

reviews.title: Text spam
reviews.text: If you ever use this app, you’ll start regularly receiving text spam

reviews.title: App is mocking me for being old fashioned.
reviews.text: Can’t find my friend’s Halloween party on the app. First time downloading and the search bar does not work for me. Nothing about this app is simple and straight to the point, and even though it’s inanimate, I can hear it mocking me for being old fashioned.

reviews.title: One of the Very Worst!
reviews.text: I’ve missed out on so many parties because the app never sends me reminders. No push notifications, no emails, no texts. It’s a wonder why people even use this thing! I only wish I could rate it lower! 🤗

reviews.title: Would give 0 stars if I could
reviews.text: Use a different event app. Any app. This does not allow you to see who has received the invite and does not let you see who has opened or viewed the invite. I have tried sending event reminders to my group if 68 people and they can open them. There is an option for sending a text blast, and characters are limited, so you’d think the text would go out to the group. Instead, another broken link goes out to the group. Turns out if you click the link once it doesn’t work again. I am not individually texting the details to the group. Ughhhhhj

reviews.title: Ex palantir founders can’t make working app
reviews.text: The app can’t correctly save edits to events. App publishers need to look into how POST requests work

reviews.title: Why do we need this app
reviews.text: Takes forever to load and half the time never does. Just let me use the website on my phone please

reviews.title: Not an app for mass events
reviews.text: During SF Tech week this app kept crashing. I was unable to get notifications about invites and it was so hard to refresh the app. This app is fine for one social event per weekend, but not for a full calendar of events.

reviews.title: Not much
reviews.text:
Update: The keyboard and messaging disappears when you switch between apps. You have to exit then go back to the chat to continue. 😅

Why is the web version so much better than the app version? I can’t see what my event decisions are at the home page, I’ll have to check each one to know. None of the events from my following are listed for me, I have to check on the web version. Web is just so much better.

reviews.title: Battery drain galore!
reviews.text: Downloaded it, immediately it started draining my battery even when I had it off. As soon as I deleted it, the battery drain stopped. Sure it’s a useful app for seeing your invites but not useful to keep when you can keep a charged phone!

reviews.title: please fix the gifs and other issues
reviews.text:
i opened the app and was filled with what i can only describe as an overwhelming sense of… disappointment?

the gifs have been broken FOREVER but instead of fixing that, we get… the release of four “premium themes”? they cost $5, mins you. it’s (1) solid black (necessary but… why isn’t this on the free solid color gradient?), (2) solid blue (see last comment), (3) water part 2, and (4) the night sky (cute). all that is to say that partiful should be ashamed! such a small range of free options and this premium stuff is plain greedy and lowkey uninspired

reviews.title: Not operational and your texts were verification does not come in
reviews.text:
It worked the first time, but afterwards, when people were sending invitations, the home screen would only come up and ask for your phone number which you would be prompted to receive a text in order to see the invitation. However, the text would never come through. (nor was it blocked). 

Once Friends also started seeing the issue, they are starting to remove this platform as it doesn’t allow all invitees to see the invitation.

reviews.title: Your phone number should not be your login.
reviews.text:
Using a phone number as your only login method is a real privacy problem. Phone numbers are personally identifiable and vulnerable to SIM-swapping attacks, which is a poor foundation for an app that holds your guest lists, locations, and personal plans.

Sign in with Apple and Google already exist for exactly this reason. They’re secure, encrypted, and put users in control of their own data. This is industry standard in 2025 and Partiful is behind the curve. Until they catch up, privacy-conscious users are stuck choosing between their personal data and using the platform.
